config.name: f3_pseudo2025
config._doc: configs/f3_final.json on 2025. Run by research/final/pseudo_final.py on 2025 Jan/Feb/Jun/Jul with month-out members. lv_rules and recovered fit nothing on labels; daily refits its parameters without the held month on the c6 chain (c6 12-month-out OOF + level calibration with offsets excluding the held month + L0 + L0e). The L1a-v2 loadings are refitted without the held month on f2x5's pseudo-final rows of the same weights mode (post_layer_pseudo). The month-out inputs equal f2x5_l1av2_pseudo2025's (the mlp7 seed count only changes the 2026 prediction), so the rows must be identical.

prc-f-x5._note: x5 pinned to xgboost 2.1.4: prc-f-x5-mo/output/oof.csv holds all four folds (M1/M6 from that run, M2/M7 copied from prc-f-x5p-mo; identical values checked). The xgboost 3.4.1 runs were renamed prc-f-x5-xgb341 / prc-f-x5-mo-xgb341 and are not used.

recipe.name: f3_pseudo2025
recipe._doc: f3 (f2x5 with 6-seed mlp7 and L1a-v2 loadings): Members are refits on the final store: d <= 1 h stack c7 (6 seeds), cs7 (3 seeds), mlp7 (6 seeds); 1-4 h stack c6s (3 seeds), c5s (3 seeds), x5 (3 seeds), c7 (6 seeds). Frozen weights: NNLS on each specification's 2025 A/B OOF (c7's from prc-c7x2, the earlier fs7 bank). x5 is the refit pinned to xgboost 2.1.4. Rows past 4 h: long stack (c6s, c5s, x5, c7) blended with the physical estimate (plog, alpha 1); rows whose AOBT_3 is more than 4 h before takeoff and LIRF rows without AOBT_3 (long.fill = long_stack) take the long stack unblended. Overlay: LIRF rows without ADS-B evidence and d <= 4 h get 0.7 pred + 0.3 k4. Cap pred <= d past 2 h. Level calibration: lam 0.75, cap 0.05, composition offset fitted on the 2025 12-month-out c6 OOF. Post layers: lv_rules with rules 'ad' (NM join window, LEMD/LEBL cap), recovered (L0e), daily (L1a; parameters research/final/levers/artifacts/daily_params.json; L1a-v2 ordinary-row loadings from research/final/levers/artifacts/daily_v2_f2x5_loadings.json), recovered again. Assembler rules: NM join window +-3,631 s, LEMD/LEBL <= 3,604 s, floor 60.
notes: Level calibration: composition offset fitted on the 2025 12-month-out c6 OOF (research/cache/oof_mo12_c6.parquet), lam 0.75, cap 0.05.
Post layers from research/final/levers; see research/final/levers/RESULTS.md.
L1a-v2 loadings fitted on f2x5's 2025 pseudo-final rows (research/final/levers/RESULTS.md, L1a-v2 section); the 2026 build reads only the fitted artifact.
mlp7: 6 seeds (prc-f-mlp7m6: r2912 from prc-f-mlp7a, r2911/r2913 from prc-f-mlp7c, r2914-r2916 from prc-f-mlp7b).
